title: Concept: Pod built with warnings suppressed
description: Podfile declares a pod that hides compiler warnings, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a pod that hides compiler warnings.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile (cocoapods).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a pod that hides compiler warnings.
